description: PITTSTON, PA — Today, Congressman Rob Bresnahan announced the launch of “Democrats for Rob.” This coalition, co-chaired by former Nanticoke Mayor and current Council President Joseph Dougherty and Jessup Borough Councilman Jeff Castellani, invites all Democrats in the district who want continued results for Northeastern Pennsylvania to join the coalition.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Democrats for Rob Coalition Launches in Support of Congressman Bresnahan's Reelection - Rob for PA
